description: Add support for WXT modules to extend entrypoint configuration options through type augmentation and HTML meta tag parsing. This will allow modules to define custom options that integrate seamlessly with WXT's existing entrypoint system and can be specified both in configuration files and directly in HTML files.
functional_requirements: Extend WXT's TypeScript types to allow modules to augment entrypoint option definitions through declaration merging
Implement HTML parsing logic to detect `<meta name='wxt.<name>' content='...' />` tags in HTML entrypoint files and convert them to entrypoint options
Ensure augmented options from modules are properly validated and merged with core entrypoint options during build processing
Update documentation with examples showing how modules can define custom options and how developers can use them in both config files and HTML
